run_at.title: Run At
run_at.description: When the Run Test whose codes these are finished (ISO 8601 UTC), or null when there is no record.

id.title: Id
id.description: The code table's id (its file name under mapping/codetables/), when the rule uses a code table.

table.title: Table
table.description: The code table's name, when the rule uses a code table.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The rule's label ('<source> → <destination>'); null for a legacy rule that carries none.

code.title: Code
code.description: The source code the last Run Test could not translate.

system.title: System
system.description: The code's system, when the source value carried one.

text.title: Text
text.description: The code's own name/text, when the source value carried one.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: The codes not found, in the order the run logged them.

400.description: The node is not a Data Map node (not_a_data_map).
